title: Ordinary open support mate preserves the constant coefficient quotient
statement: Let A be any commutative ring and h:S→T an open immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let b:B→T and d:D→S be closed immersions with d.openComplement = h⁻¹(b.openComplement). For the normalized supported-coefficient adjunctions [def-pur-supported-exterior-product] and the actual ordinary support restriction r [lem-pur-support-restriction-triangle], let α:C_d→C_b h* be its left mate. For every A-module M, e_d(M) α(M) = (h*constant≅constant)⁻¹(M) h*(e_b(M)), where e_b,e_d are the specified quotients from constant coefficients. No finiteness or flatness is assumed.

source.place: Tags 09XP and 0F1E; coefficient normalization in step 11 of lem-pur-supported-product-localization, with exact derived mate calculation.

proof.text: Apply the supported coefficient adjunction on S. The mate unit formula identifies the adjunct with the old unit followed by r. The defining kernel-inclusion equation of r and naturality of global inverse image identify this with pullback of the old constant adjunct. The normalization of the supported coefficient adjunction on T is the quotient e_b. Compatibility of constant adjunction units with inverse image therefore identifies the map with the pulled-back quotient. Injectivity of the constant adjunction Hom equivalence proves the equality. This includes zero modules and empty supports and opens.

theorem supportedCoefficientOpenMate_quotient (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {T S B D : Scheme.{u}} (h : S ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion h]
    (b : B ⟶ T) (d : D ⟶ S) [IsClosedImmersion b] [IsClosedImmersion d]
    (hd : d.openComplement = h ⁻¹ᵁ b.openComplement) (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) :
    supportedCoefficientQuotient A d M ≫
      (supportCoefficientMate (supportedCoefficientAdjunction A b)
        (supportedCoefficientAdjunction A d) (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h)
        (supportTransport A h b d hd)).app M =
    (Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).inv.app M ≫
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).map (supportedCoefficientQuotient A b M)
